title: GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.20736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. translated_title: GainCtrl：通过预测剩余收益实现高效的LLM智能体执行
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于驱动与工具和环境交互以解决复杂任务的智能体。重复尝试能够提升使用工具的智能体的质量，但即使最终返回的最佳结果不太可能得到改善，持续执行仍会产生额外成本。这就引出了一个问题：何时停止一次尝试，以便在保持任务级Best-of-N质量的同时降低执行成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GainCtrl，一种基于收益的LLM执行控制器。在GainCtrl中，一个轻量级的CPU预测器利用交互历史来估计相对于已保留分数的期望正收益，进而通过经过校准的阈值来指导停止决策，以限制平均Best-of-N任务质量的损失。我们通过在三个环境和三个LLM执行者上进行轨迹回放来评估该控制器。对插值后的质量-成本帕累托前沿的比较表明，GainCtrl……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GainCtrl提出了一种基于收益的LLM智能体执行控制器，利用轻量级CPU预测器根据交互历史估计剩余期望收益，并通过校准阈值决定何时停止尝试，从而在降低执行成本的同时保持Best-of-N任务质量。
en_tdlr: GainCtrl is a gain-based execution controller for LLM agents that uses a lightweight CPU predictor to estimate expected remaining gains from interaction histories and guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds, reducing execution cost while preserving Best-of-N task quality.
